1.hint: Step 1 - Determine the Running PostgreSQL Version - sudo -iu postgres

2.hint: Step 1 - Determine the Running PostgreSQL Version - psql -c "SELECT version();"

3.hint: Step 1 - Determine the Running PostgreSQL Version - /usr/pgsql-16/bin/postgres --version

4.hint: Step 1 - Determine the Running PostgreSQL Version - exit

5.hint: Step 2 - Determine How PostgreSQL Was Installed - rpm -q postgresql16-server

6.hint: Step 2 - Determine How PostgreSQL Was Installed - dnf list installed | grep postgres

7.hint: Step 2 - Determine How PostgreSQL Was Installed - ls /opt/pg-src/bin/postgres

8.hint: Step 2 - Determine How PostgreSQL Was Installed - /opt/pg-src/bin/postgres --version

9.hint: Step 3 - Map All Binaries, Config Files, and Data Directories - rpm -ql postgresql16-server | grep bin

10.hint: Step 3 - Map All Binaries, Config Files, and Data Directories - rpm -ql postgresql16 | grep bin

11.hint: Step 3 - Map All Binaries, Config Files, and Data Directories - sudo -iu postgres

12.hint: Step 3 - Map All Binaries, Config Files, and Data Directories - psql -c "SHOW config_file;"

13.hint: Step 3 - Map All Binaries, Config Files, and Data Directories - psql -c "SHOW hba_file;"

14.hint: Step 3 - Map All Binaries, Config Files, and Data Directories - psql -c "SHOW data_directory;"

15.hint: Step 3 - Map All Binaries, Config Files, and Data Directories - exit

16.hint: Step 4 - Check the PGDG Repository Configuration - sudo su -

17.hint: Step 4 - Check the PGDG Repository Configuration - dnf repolist | grep pgdg

18.hint: Step 4 - Check the PGDG Repository Configuration - dnf list available | grep postgresql | grep server

19.hint: Step 4 - Check the PGDG Repository Configuration - exit

20.hint: Step 5 - Verify the Systemd Service Configuration - sudo systemctl status postgresql-16

22.hint: Step 5 - Verify the Systemd Service Configuration - sudo systemctl cat postgresql-16

23.hint: Step 5 - Verify the Systemd Service Configuration - ls /etc/systemd/system/postgresql-16.service.d/ 2>/dev/null

24.hint: Step 5 - Verify the Systemd Service Configuration - override.conf
